title: The Organizational Singularity: How AI Breaks the Firm and Rewrites It to Solve Everything
limitations: Prescriptive organizational transformation manuscript and directional forecasts. 2036 scenarios, radical workforce reduction ratios, and specific proprietary frameworks (ExO 3.0, Intelligence Stack, REWRITE) are forward-looking hypotheses rather than established empirical findings. Steelman counterarguments (such as the hidden costs of delayering and the missing junior apprenticeship loop) are acknowledged within the text.
